in_marathi.name: Charuvrat
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desirable or Lovable Chariot
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charuvrat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Charuvrat is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Charu' which means desirable or lovable and 'Vrat' which means chariot. This name suggests a person who is desirable or lovable, just like a chariot that is loved and cherished. It is a powerful and evocative name that is sure to leave a lasting impression.
